svg.title: Men's CAP dark blue polo, short sleeves, left chest pocket, with medium gray trousers and black belt (embroidery positions only)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-polo-male","name":"Men's CAP dark blue polo, short sleeves, left chest pocket, with medium gray trousers and black belt (embroidery positions only)","size_in":{"w":25.058,"h":29.48},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2505.8,2948],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Silhouette traced from CAPR 39-1 Figure 5.5 (3 March 2020, p.80; base-art/ref_polo_CAPR_fig5-5.png, PDF page 108 rendered at 300 dpi, trace-polo.js: shirt-only mask, left half mirrored, Moore trace, RDP 1.1 px). Scale 0.0309 in per figure pixel: the figure's belt buckle is 64 x 66 px, so 1.98 x 2.04 in at this scale against the 2 in limit of CAPR 39-1 5.3.5 (the figure draws the buckle at the limit), and the armhole-seam width (2 x 9.53 in) equals the men's Class B shirt sheet's (167 px x 0.0474 x 1.2171 = 9.63 in half width), i.e. the same wearer. At this scale the figure's embroidered seal is 2.93 in across, the placket 1.30 x 5.41 in, the pocket 4.17 in wide, the belt 1.79 in. ESTIMATE: the regulation gives no garment dimension and the figure is a schematic drawing. Shirt colour #171b1f (shadow #0f1215, highlight #1d2228), sampled in-browser from the Vanguard product photo of the CAP uniform golf shirt with seal (male, not personalized), SKU CAP0320, https://www.vanguardmil.com/cdn/shop/files/CAP0321_1.jpg (1024 x 1024); shirt pixels = every pixel with max channel < 140 and blue >= red and >= green, n = 458,157 of 1,048,576, sorted by luminance; percentiles p5 #0f1317, p25 #14181b, p50 #181c1f, p75 #1a1f24, p95 #1d242d; means: shadow p0-p10 #0f1215, body p30-p70 #171b1f, lit face p60-p90 #1a1f23, lit p85-p97 #1d2228; one photo, so estimated. Body = the p30-p70 mean, highlight lines = the p85-p97 mean, shadow / outline = the p0-p10 mean. Replaces the Figure 5.5 drawing's #001b52, which was too saturated. Belt #201a18, trousers #746f6c, skirt #86827e are sampled from the Figure 5.5 drawing (the photo set does not show them).","anchors":{"top_center":[1252.9,0],"bottom_center":[1252.9,2948],"center":[1252.9,1474],"left_edge":[0,1474],"right_edge":[2505.8,1474],"shoulder_seam_right":[299.63,402.43],"shoulder_seam_left":[2206.16,402.43],"collar_apex":[1252.9,585.8],"hem_center":[1252.9,2398.57],"hat_attach":[1252.9,10],"button_1_center":[1249.81,697.22],"button_2_center":[1248.26,969.44],"placket_top_center":[1252.9,594.01],"seal_center":[796.2,805.37],"name_center":[1731.85,841.52],"badge_center":[1731.85,714.43],"print_seal_center":[1709.6,805.37],"pocket_top_center":[1731.85,912.28],"belt_buckle_center":[1252.9,2308.96]},"landmarks":{"collar_right":[[1541.8,13.1],[1810.6,495.1],[1517.1,476.6],[1252.9,594]],"collar_left":[[964,13.1],[695.2,495.1],[988.7,476.6],[1252.9,594]],"pocket":{"x":1523.27,"y":912.28,"w":417.15,"h":448.05},"belt_buckle":{"x":1154.02,"y":2206.99,"w":197.76,"h":203.94},"placket":{"x":1188,"y":594,"w":129.8,"h":540.7},"seal_slot":{"x":796.2,"y":805.37,"w_in":2.93,"h_in":2.93},"name_slot":{"x":1731.85,"y":841.52,"w_in":4.2,"h_in":0.4},"badge_slot":{"x":1731.85,"y":714.43,"w_in":1.2,"h_in":1.14,"gap_to_name_in":0.5},"print_seal_slot":{"x":1709.6,"y":805.37,"w_in":2.93,"h_in":2.93},"pen_pocket_slot":{"x":2264.25,"y":897.4,"w_in":1.4,"h_in":5.5,"angle_deg":-0.8,"flap_in":1.35},"hat_view":{"front":{"x":852.9,"y":-665,"w":800,"h":700},"back":{"x":1702.9,"y":-475,"w":800,"h":510}}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} (top-left); polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. The *_slot entries that carry w_in / h_in are {x,y} = the CENTRE of the slot in user units, w_in / h_in in inches. seal_slot: embroidered CAP seal, wearer's RIGHT breast (the picture's left), w_in = the figure-measured seal (2.93 in; the insignia-cap-seal asset is 2.50 in, CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-4: the figure draws the polo seal larger, the engine places the asset at the slot centre). pen_pocket_slot: the tactical polo's pen pocket on the wearer's LEFT sleeve (the picture's right), {x,y} its centre, w_in x h_in its size (1.4 x 5.5 in, estimate), angle_deg the SVG rotate() that turns an upright box onto the sleeve's axis, flap_in the flap depth. name_slot: the embroidered name line on the wearer's LEFT breast, w_in = the pocket width 4.17 rounded to 4.2 in; the name sits above the pocket, as Figure 5.5 draws it (0.53 in clear of the pocket top), h_in = the figure's cap height. badge_slot: centre of the badge / duty title line, h_in 1.14 (the figure's badge), 1/2 in above the name_slot top (CAPR 39-1 5.3.2.1.1; the figure draws 0.65 in), w_in nominal. print_seal_slot: the screen-printed CAP seal (5.3.1.2) on the wearer's LEFT breast, the seal_slot mirrored about the centre line; the men's sheet's pocket group (id pocket) is hidden for the printed polo, which has no pocket or accoutrements (5.3.1.2, 5.3.2.1.2). collar_left / collar_right name the leaf on the PICTURE's left / right (as the Class B sheets do); shoulder_seam_right / left and every anchor named left / right are the WEARER's (right = the picture's left). hat_view {front, back}: where the cap assets hat-baseball-cap-blue and hat-baseball-cap-blue-back sit (their boxes, bottoms 0.25 in below the collar-tip line, the back view 0.5 in to the picture's right of the front);
